title: Permit Application Package — Permits, Inspections and Occupancy Approvals
body:
Permit Application Package. This record belongs to the Permits, Inspections and Occupancy Approvals database and covers permit application package in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers permit workflows, inspection stages, documentation and occupancy approval processes.

Actual content. Permit Application Package is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it. Fourth, record the as-built result, including any deviation from the plan and the reason for it, so the next trade and the next inspection can rely on the record. A complete permit application package entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.
